race.description: Racing On Melbourne Cup Day Hcp (Bm55)
race.comment: TAMBO'S SISTER (12) resumes here but the form she showed in her first preparation was good enough to be competitive in a race of this nature. Revved up for this with a recent trial and looks the runner in this field with the most upside. Capable of a strong showing while fresh. PORRISTA (3) is having her first run for the new stable but has placed when first-up before and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Worth plenty of thought. EXTRA FREE (8) is a two-time winner over this track and trip and is more than capable enough on his day. Top-three aspirations. BOOM BUNNY (10) doesn't win out of turn but is usually thereabouts and is a must for the multiples. KICKOFF (4) put back-to-back wins together before the spell and must be respected with Wiggins on board.
